artifacts.title: osTicket email alias to Mattermost and config credential leak (Delivery)
artifacts.starting_access: unauthenticated access to nginx and Mattermost on a Debian 10 host
artifacts.outcome: root via Mattermost MySQL hash crack and credential leak
transferable_properties: business logic flaws don't need CVEs, two legitimate systems can bypass email verification
read all messages in internal platforms, developers share credentials in private channels
application config files like config.json contain database credentials
password hints narrow the cracking space dramatically
full port scan is mandatory, Mattermost on 8065 was missed by a default scan

observations: page source reveals helpdesk.delivery.htb and Mattermost

hypotheses.statement: osTicket can hand out a @delivery.htb email alias that satisfies Mattermost registration

selected_action.intent: open a guest ticket on osTicket to obtain a @delivery.htb alias, then register on Mattermost

evidence.summary: opened an osTicket guest ticket that got assigned 4662359@delivery.htb, used it to register on Mattermost and received the verification link in the ticket

observations: internal channel contains credentials and a password hint

hypotheses.statement: the leaked maildeliverer credentials work over SSH

selected_action.intent: read the internal channel and try the leaked credentials over SSH

evidence.summary: found maildeliverer:[REDACTED] in the internal channel and logged in over SSH as maildeliverer

hypotheses.statement: the MySQL config reveals a root bcrypt hash we can crack with the hinted base word

selected_action.intent: dump the Mattermost Users table and crack the root bcrypt hash with rules

evidence.summary: extracted the root bcrypt hash from MySQL and cracked it using the PleaseSubscribe! base word with john best64 rules

observations: the cracked password is the root system password

hypotheses.statement: su root with the cracked password grants a root shell

selected_action.intent: run su root with the cracked password

evidence.summary: used su root with the cracked password and obtained a root shell
